concerns.concern: The fractional charge q/e = ν/N depends entirely on N once the stripe slope is fixed by ν. N is taken from field-period ratios under an assumed constant antidot area, and the ΔV/ΔVe cross-check assumes the same area and gate coupling at every filling. The review asks for unrounded ratios with errors and an area estimate that does not rely on N.
concerns.quote: N comes from the field-period ratio to ν = 2 under a constant area (Fig. 4b), and the diameters in Fig. 4c use those same N values.

concerns.concern: Integer and fractional gate periods have not been compared in the same gate-voltage range, so a filling-dependent antidot area (as Hata et al. found at ν = 2/3) is not excluded.
concerns.quote: Integer and fractional gate periods compared in the same gate-voltage range: no

concerns.concern: The field period could instead be set by the number of charged edges. The argument rejecting edge counting at ν = 4/3 needs the side-gate separation stated next to the implied diameter, and the same argument is missing for 5/3, 7/3 and 8/3.
concerns.quote: Give the side-gate separation next to the N = 2 diameter at 4/3, and run the same argument at 5/3, 7/3 and 8/3.

concerns.concern: The oscillations may be in an Aharonov-Bohm or mixed regime rather than Coulomb-dominated, as the paper's own bias data at ν = 4/3 suggest. The review asks for FFT analysis looking for an opposite-slope stripe family and a temperature series at a fractional filling.
concerns.quote: consistent with an Aharonov–Bohm–like mechanism rather than a purely Coulomb-dominated regime.

concerns.concern: Charge traps or side dots could produce the extra small-period oscillation at ν = 8/3, which appears only in certain regions, and the jumps in Figs. S11c and S17a. The review asks for resweeps and for checking whether the stripes appear in bottom-gate sweeps.
concerns.quote: since this occurs only in certain regions, we have decided to retain both points.

concerns.concern: No sweeps were repeated at identical settings, so reproducible shifts cannot be separated from stochastic charge jumps.
concerns.quote: Several maps per fraction at other D and B (Figs. S13 to S16, S18); none at identical settings

concerns.concern: Gate leakage is not checked or reported.
The ν = 7/3 result rests on a single map, and no second dataset is shown.
It is unclear which other ν = 8/3 maps show the small-period oscillation. The regions where it is absent are not shown.
concerns.quote: show a second 7/3 dataset and the regions without the small 8/3 period.

concerns.concern: The paper does not report how many devices and cooldowns were measured, how many showed fractional oscillations, or why others were set aside. It also does not say at which fractions oscillations were sought but not resolved.
concerns.quote: totals fabricated and cooldowns are not given.

concerns.concern: The full field, gate and displacement-field ranges measured beyond the shown windows are not disclosed, nor how each window inside a plateau was chosen.
concerns.quote: Which field, gate and displacement-field ranges did you measure beyond the windows shown in Fig. 3 and Figs. S13 to S18

concerns.concern: There are inconsistencies about which device the data come from. Fig. S9g-l is attributed to AD #1 in the text and AD #2 in the caption. The p. 3 claim of fractional states at 8 T conflicts with a p. 11 note on their absence at 8 T.
concerns.quote: the p. 20 text says AD #1, the caption says AD #2

concerns.concern: The processing pipeline is not fully open. A current scaling factor is tuned so the ν = 2 plateau is quantized, data are only available on request, and no code is provided.
concerns.quote: data are "available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request" (p. 10), with no code.
